topic: Sea slugs steal weapons and sunlight
script: Some sea slugs steal weapons from the animals they eat. Certain nudibranchs eat stinging creatures and store the unfired stingers in their own bodies. Then they use those stolen stingers to defend themselves. Another kind of sea slug steals the parts of algae that turn sunlight into food. It can then live partly on sunlight, a bit like a plant. In 2021, scientists found some sea slugs can even regrow a whole body from just the head. Follow Pixel Abyss for more strange facts from the deep.
